snippet.title: The Huge Detail We Missed In The Avengers Doomsday Trailer!
snippet.description:
The Huge Detail We Missed In The Avengers Doomsday Trailer. Robert Downey Jr Doctor Doom, Russo Bros Avengers Time Runs Out New Material & Avengers Secret Wars Teaser ► https://bit.ly/AwesomeSubscribe
Avengers Doomsday Trailer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DFGkcteQgAg&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwWT3yd94Xc6n-ooI85uV_u&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
X-Men 2028 Teaser https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TBSPL-P-LCs&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwWT3yd94Xc6n-ooI85uV_u&index=2&pp=iAQBsAgC
Lanterns Episode 1 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kAOsaEsKsQw&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwCLH9RIm-7ui56ameRYmdQ&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
House Of The Dragon Season 3 Episode 8 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vTtyyFhtNDg&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxGuSDE8NtOuthqbKFChC0q&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
Knight Of The Seven Kingdoms Season 2 Teaser https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OErJ5Oo5ZO4&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxGuSDE8NtOuthqbKFChC0q&index=28&pp=iAQB0gcJCcoLAYcqIYzvsAgC
Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WOfZwL4NKFE&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczwWT3yd94Xc6n-ooI85uV_u&index=1&pp=iAQBsAgC
Emergency Awesome New Videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeOfhzu7ZdY&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxQXxyV_2D8kuEs_QsuQIyJ&index=7

Covering New Avengers Doomsday Hidden Details, Russo Bros new Time Runs Out Material. More clues and Doctor Doom Backstory. Why Tobey Maguire fights Wolverine, Deadpool and the X-Men. Sadie Sink Jean Grey X-Men Ending Explained. How the ending sets up Sadie Sink's Jean Grey for all her future X-Men Movies, and her new MCU Origin Story. The Hulk Ending, and why Hulk also skips Avengers Doomsday, but returns during Avengers Secret Wars. Deadpool and Wolverine Return.

And what happens with Spider-Man 5 and other future Spider-Man movies. Tom Holland Spider-Man Evolution, Hulk Scenes Explained. Jon Bernthal Punisher. Tobey Maguire & Andrew Garfield Spider-Man Easter Eggs. Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink. Jean Grey New Powers Explained. New Spider-Man AI and Suit Tech Explained. Spider-Man vs Damage Control, X-Men Jean Grey, Bruce Banner Savage Hulk, Sadie Sink New Character, Spider-Man vs Punisher. Tom Holland and Jon Bernthal reunion. New Spider-Man Suit First Look. Hulk Announcement. Why Bruce Banner would help Spider-Man, Spider-Man vs Hulk, Spider-Man Movies previous references to The Hulk. The Scorpion Returns, Tombstone, Jackal and other new villains. Miles Morales Spider-Man Easter Eggs.

Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink Jean Grey, Jean Grey Phoenix Powers. Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene & Avengers Doomsday Trailer Connection. Robert Downey Jr Doctor Doom, New Black Panther, X-Men, Doctor Strange, Avengers Secret Wars First Look, Battleworld MCU. Fantastic Four, Franklin Richards. Ian McKellen Magneto, Patrick Stewart Professor X, Kelsey Grammer Beast, Thor Returns, Mystique, Cyclops, Nightcrawler, Original X-Men.

Why Marvel is rebooting the MCU with Avengers 6 Secret Wars. What's going to change with all the Avengers, New Iron Man, X-Men Mutants like Wolverine, Deadpool, Fantastic Four, Ghost Rider, Spider-Man and other characters. Lots more Marvel Trailers coming Avengers Doomsday Trailer and Avengers Secret Wars videos.

My Lanterns Episode 2 video will post sun after they release it!

- Savage – Original Design by Adam Kubert

In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.

Watch the final trailer for Coyote vs. Acme, an upcoming live-action/animated hybrid comedy film starring Will Forte, Lana Condor, Tone Bell, and John Cena.

After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, mangled by magnets, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, sprung by springs, steamrolled by steamrollers, maligned by misfires, bedeviled by bungees, rattled by rockets, backstabbed by bat suits, rocked by rocket skates, upended by unicycles, quaked by quake pills, rubberized by rogue bands, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote (Genius) finally fights back. Teaming up with billboard accident lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte), he takes on slick corporate counsel Buddy Crane (John Cena) and ACME, Inc., the profit-obsessed conglomerate behind every one of the Coyote’s chaotic catastrophes.

Coyote vs. Acme is produced by Chris DeFaria and James Gunn. The screenplay is by Samy Burch. The screen story is by James Gunn & Jeremy Slater and Samy Burch.

snippet.title: SAM TOMPKINS - HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (THE FRAY COVER)
snippet.description:
Listen to HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (my version): https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/HTSALID

My sophomore album "ARE WE GONNA SING?" is out September 4th 2026. Pre-order now from https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/AreWeGonnaSingID

3 and a half years ago, i was in my living room and i decided to record a cover of one of my favourite songs of all time. i pressed record and as soon as i got the take i new it was special. we posted a vid that night and i went to watch the football… a couple hours later i checked my phone. it was blowing up.

i kept refreshing my page over and over again and it just kept going up. it felt so good. so many people saying the cover took them back to their youth listening to the original like i used to, some were saying it felt like a brand new song to them and to a few it was genuinely a song they hadn’t heard before (this made me feel old).

the following year i posted it again and it blew up even more, but my life was kinda in a strange place. the band who originally wrote the song even commented on one of the videos saying I’d killed it. (I was hoping this was in a good way)

I took a break from releasing music a little while after this cos i lost my dad. my house got robbed also and my old laptop i recorded this on was stolen. 

i came back at the start of this year with some new music. i announced a tour and stuff and was just getting settled back into the swing of things and a few weeks ago on a bit of a random one, i decided to post the cover again. this time it totally went insane. turned out so many of you had been patiently waiting for literal years for me to post it. the fray started interacting with my videos. they told me they preferred my version and then even pushed me to release it.

anyway last week i got in the studio, brought my $200 mic i recorded the original version on and made it happen. i thought I’d lost the original files when my laptop got stolen but found them on a hard drive. 

it’s kinda crazy… some of the vocals here are the same from 2023, before my dad passed, before a lot of stuff happened, and the rest is now where things are so different, but for some reason it feels special. 

i think this song itself has meant so much to me throughout my life and even when recording the original cover, it means something very different to now. that’s what makes music so special. a different voice, melody, a different mindset, any slight change can breath new life into something like this.

anyway, thank you so much for waiting and i’m so grateful. love you guys.

how to save a life (my version) is out now on everything! love you so much !

special thanks to the fray for being so cool throughout this process and even more importantly thanks to you guys for being so supportive as always. 

and on that note, if you wanna be extra awesome and nice and cool, please if you have a chance pre order my album from my store below or grab a ticket to the tour. it would mean infinite amounts to me.

snippet.title: FUR vs EG - VCT Americas Stage 2 Play-Ins - Day 7
snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

On this channel, you’ll find long-form video essays about gaming’s biggest stories from studio collapses and corporate greed to the creative risks that still push the medium forward. I break down industry trends, publisher decisions, and the economics behind how games are made, marketed, and sold.

Whether it’s GTA 6, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3, Path of Exile 2, Call of Duty, Battlefield, Pokémon, or the next doomed live-service experiment, I cover how the industry’s biggest names keep shaping and breaking the games we play. 

From deep dive analysis on publishers like EA, Bungie, Blizzard, Activision, Ubisoft, Sony, and Microsoft to commentary on indie hits like Palworld and Expedition 33, every video cuts through the marketing to get to what actually matters: how this industry works, who it’s failing, and why players deserve better.

snippet.title: 🔴 'REX INFERNUS' FULL EASTER EGG HUNT DAY 2 (Black Ops 7 Zombies)
snippet.description:
This #OfficialRexInfernusRace is a live event hosted by Activision, Treyarch, Evanf1997, and CBGray. Teams from across the world will compete, collaborate, or a mix of both, to be the first in the world to complete the 'Rex Infernus' Easter Egg legitimately. The team that wins this race will receive signed copies of the Call of Duty Zombies 'Art Book' signed by the developers themselves, and 2400 COD Points respectively.
--------------------------------------------------
The Rex Infernus Easter Egg will go live at the same time as the map at 12PM EST / 9AM PST / 5PM UK. You can watch my POV here, on Twitch, or watch ZombieZone live at Treyarch HQ on @evanf1997 and @cbgray's channels. Once again, this is an official Activision event, so all rules they have laid out for us will be respected for the duration of this Egg Hunt / Race.

snippet.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker — Console Footage
snippet.description:
Here is the console footage for The Blood of Dawnwalker, showcasing the quality mode on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X.

***
The Blood of Dawnwalker is the first chapter of Rebel Wolves’ brand new role-playing saga — a single-player open-world dark fantasy action-RPG with a strong focus on story and narrative. Developed on Unreal Engine 5 for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox X|S.

Coming 3 September 2026. Pre-order today at https://dawnwalkergame.com/buy

14th-century Europe. Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the Black Death comes for the survivors. Vampires seize their opportunity to walk out of the shadows and claim what they've been denied for centuries: freedom, and the power that comes with it.

You play as Coen, a young man turned into a #Dawnwalker, forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night. Fight for your humanity or embrace the cursed powers to save your family. Whatever your choice, the question stands: is your soul worth the lives of those you love?
